game: PHI@GB Week 10 2025, kickoff 2025-11-10 20:15 ET, Lambeau outdoors, GB -1.5, total 45.5

script.base: Market prices a one-score game: GB 23.5 implied, PHI 22.0, spread only 1.5 so no blowout clock-kill and no forced underdog pass script (that flag starts at 3.5). Pack windows are PHI weeks 6-8 and GB weeks 7-9, so PHI is the extra-rest side. Base flow is competitive into the fourth, both QBs throwing, Barkley (~62% of listed PHI rush attempts, 44 of 71) and Jacobs (~60% of listed GB rushes, 43 of 72) staying involved, Wilson still mixing in (23 carries). Moderate 45.5 total, not a shootout and not a slog.
script.flip1: GB leads by 10+ early at home. Jacobs/Wilson carries rise late, Love/Doubs/Kraft snaps and yards stall, PHI abandons the run so Barkley rush dies and Smith/Brown/Goedert targets spike.
script.flip2: Rested PHI scores first and leads. GB throws more (Doubs/Kraft targets up, Jacobs rush dies), PHI leans on Barkley to close and Smith/Brown yardage stalls.

injury_fallout: Source is the pre-game nflverse injury report only; inactives ~90 minutes pre-kick are not in the pack. GB: CB Nate Hobbs OUT (knee) — slot-corner loss, next beneficiaries are PHI slot/TE/RB and only indirectly Smith/Brown; DE Lukas Van Ness OUT (foot) — small GB pass-rush downgrade, slight help to PHI protection; T Zach Tom-listed as Zach Bako-Bewele Q (back), WR Dontayvion Wicks Q (calf), WR Savion Williams Q (foot), WR Matthew Golden Q (shoulder). If Wicks/Golden are limited, Doubs (already 24 targets in GB's last 3) and Kraft (22) absorb; Golden himself is a snap-limit risk, not a clean over. PHI: CB Jaire Alexander OUT (knee) and CB Jakorian Bennett Q (pectoral) — GB outside WRs, especially Doubs, face a downgraded coverage unit; C Cam Jurgens OUT (knee) and C Willie Lampkin Q (knee) — interior OL crisis, rushing efficiency down, pressure up, more quick throws (RB/TE catches up, deep WR air yards down); LB Nolan Smith Q (triceps) — if out, GB protection and the run get a small edge. No snap-share history for the backups is in the pack.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Proxy only: GB blitzes 23% (mostly four-man), PHI blitzes 29%.
matchup.pressure: PHI EPA/db is 0.09 vs blitz and 0.15 vs none, so GB's low blitz rate gives PHI its better look, but Jurgens out raises PHI's own pressure risk. GB EPA/db is 0.42 vs blitz vs 0.27 vs none — Love beats pressure, and PHI's 29% blitz can feed GB explosives rather than kill them. Van Ness out is a minor GB rush downgrade.
matchup.bleeds: GB defense allows 3.98 YPC and only 13 runs of 10+ in 8 games; pass YPA left 5.2 (101 att), middle 7.29 (76), right 5.54 (113); 14 passes of 20+ for 312 yards. PHI defense allows 4.54 YPC and 26 runs of 10+; YPA left 7.21 (100), middle 5.74 (50), right 6.91 (115); 23 passes of 20+ for only 281 yards.
matchup.overlap: PHI's recent primary is Smith (25 targets, 337 air yards in weeks 6-8), which attacks GB's sound perimeter, not the middle bleed. The structural middle overlap is Goedert (17 targets) but his yards are one-spike (110, then 19/18/28). GB's overlap is Doubs (24 targets, 348 air yards) into PHI's outside bleed plus Alexander out. Kraft (22 targets, 69 air yards, YAC profile) attacks PHI's better middle, so he is not the overlap.

form: Role, not season averages. Smith last4 recyds 114, 49, 183, 84 vs stand-in 56.5, and weeks 6-8 are 25 targets / 316 yards — a real role surge, one miss. Brown last4 7, 43, 80, 121 but only 15 targets in that same window, so he is not the primary. Goedert last4 19, 110, 18, 28 — the 110 is fluky; the other three miss 33.5. Barkley rush last4 30, 58, 44, 150 on 44 carries / 252 yards in weeks 6-8, with Bigsby 10/115 in that window; the 150 is the explosive GB's run defense rarely allows. Jacobs rush last4 93, 55, 33, 87 but weeks 7-9 are only 43/175 with Wilson 23/94. Doubs last4 55, 72, 44, 91 and 24 targets / 207 yards on 348 air — volume is real, conversion is not (8.6 yards per target). Kraft last4 43, 58, 143, 20 is spike-driven. Golden last4 86, 37, 4, 9 and 10 targets / 50 yards, shrinking, plus shoulder Q. No similar-defense game logs in the pack.

pre_mortem: It's Tuesday and both overs lost. GB's perimeter (5.2 and 5.54 YPA) and the Jurgens/Lampkin interior problem turned PHI into quick throws; Smith posted another 49-yard night while Goedert and Barkley caught the checkdowns, and Brown took the downfield shots. Doubs' air yards failed again — PHI has allowed 23 passes of 20+ but only 281 yards on them — Golden and Wicks played, and either GB led and Jacobs (PHI allows 4.54 YPC and 26 runs of 10+) closed it, or Love checked to Kraft in the middle where PHI is actually sound at 5.74 YPA. Alexander's absence was real and still did not move Doubs over 56.5. That counter is strong enough that both legs are leans, not bets, until a price and inactives exist.
slip_story: One competitive pass-volume story, not a shootout stack (total is only 45.5) and not a favorite clock-kill stack. The two WR yardage overs need the game to stay inside one score; either blowout flip kills one leg, so the slip is script-dependent even though each leg survives the base plus one flip. Do not add a total under, a TD, a Jacobs rush over, or a second market on either player. Golden recyds under 26.5 would fit the GB target-consolidation story only if he is active and limited; he is Questionable and inactives are not in the pack, so he stays off.
